params.name: take

params.description: Number of response items to skip

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Specifies fields and order to sort the response items

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of domains, allowing the use of query parameters to customize the response. This operation is essential for efficiently managing large collections of domains, enabling smooth navigation and retrieval without overloading the system with unnecessary data. ### Required Permissions - domains:read ### Rate Limits * The limit for fetching a domain list is 300 requests per user, within 300 seconds.

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain name in ASCII format (A-label) whose details are to be fetched. The domain name must be provided in a fully qualified domain format.

items.docs: Get details of a specific domain. ### Required Permissions - domains:read ### Rate Limits * The limit for obtaining info for a domain is 5 requests per domain, within 300 seconds.
Register a specific domain. ### Required Permissions - domains:billing ### Rate Limits * The limit to register domains is 30 requests per user, within 30 seconds.
